newsitem.title: USA: Kinnard fills two senior manager posts.
newsitem.headline: Kinnard fills two senior manager posts.

text.p: Kinnard Investments Inc said Tuesday it named William Farley as chief operating officer and a board member of the company. In addition, Farley was named chairman of the board, president and chief executive officer of John G. Kinnard & Co, a regional brokerage that is the primary subsidiary of Kinnard Investments.
The company also said it named Charles Westling senior vice president and director of corporate finance and a member of the board of John G. Kinnard.
Farley's most recent position was as vice chairman of First Bank System Inc. The posts at John G. Kinnard that he fills were vacant for the past 16 months.
Westling, who has a background in investment banking, most recently was with Dain Bosworth Inc. He fills a position vacated at yearend 1996 by Michael Norton.
